title: Slot class
description: A semantic-and-POS bucket a word may fill. See docs/seams.md §Seam 2, 'Slot classes'.

id.description: e.g. adj.quality.light, or a further-split noun.abstract.emotion.dread when one semantic bucket needs two siblings. Must match the filename.

pos.description: Coarse part of speech every member must satisfy when substituted into fixture.

description.description: The editorial boundary of this bucket — why a word is in it and what would put a word outside it.

fixture.description: A sentence with a single {word} placeholder, in a syntactic position that disambiguates pos. The class's only real defence: every member must substitute in and stay grammatical.
